standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The sun motif remains readable, but the round foundation has a visibly polygonal outline.

rear.note: The opposite view retains the same coarse edge and sharp raised rays, which read as folded leaves rather than woven inlay.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows a polygonal center and large angular lifted rays; refine the radial textile construction within the original dimensions.

underside.note: The closed backing is intact, but its coarse circular perimeter is obvious against the dark background.

clay.note: Clay confirms the rays stand up as angular ridges and the circular silhouette needs denser sampling.

front.note: The wraparound back and swivel base remain recognizable, but the seat edge has puckered corners and exposed dark pan tips.

rear.note: The shell and arm supports remain connected; the seat defect needs an isolated cover and welt correction.

detail.note: The close view shows buried and wavy seat piping and a black pan corner protruding through the white cushion.

underside.note: The closed seat pan and swivel mechanism remain supported, but pan corners extend beyond the softened cushion.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the uneven seat seam is geometric; preserve the smooth wraparound shell while correcting seat contact.

front.note: The chair keeps its distinct pedestal and separate back, but the seat has uneven corner piping and dark projecting corners.

rear.note: The upright back remains aligned with the seat; its simple rectangular upholstery reads consistently with the original design.

detail.note: Full-size inspection exposes the irregular welt sinking into the cushion and a black support corner above the cover edge.

underside.note: The swivel disc, column and pan are closed and connected; fit the pan corners inside the actual seat cover.

clay.note: Clay confirms the seat seam is irregular rather than a material highlight; reshape only this bounded cushion and welt.

front.note: The refined warm ceramic base and hollow linen shade retain the original lamp proportions with smoother outlines.

rear.note: The opposite side shows a continuous tapered shade and seated brass neck without the original coarse banding.

detail.note: The shade fabric is restrained at this scale and the base-to-neck transition is clean.

underside.note: The underside exposes actual shade lining and support spokes around the socket, with a closed ceramic base.

clay.note: Clay confirms the open shade and smoother turned base are construction improvements rather than only surface changes.

front.note: The named five-drawer chest visibly has only three large front panels; its source cabinet layout needs a specific correction.

rear.note: The rear and toe kick form a coherent tall cabinet, but do not resolve the front count mismatch.

detail.note: The detailed view confirms three pulls and three fronts rather than five stacked drawers.

underside.note: The base is closed and supported; preserve this envelope while fitting the correct five-front arrangement.

clay.note: Clay confirms the three-panel layout is modeled geometry and remains inconsistent with the catalog name.

front.note: The tall pantry reads clearly through three aligned door panels, recessed pulls and a narrow toe kick.

rear.note: The closed rear and continuous side panels retain the full-height cabinet proportions.

detail.note: Door gaps and finger pulls remain clean and distinct, with softened manufactured edges.

underside.note: The closed lower carcass sits over an inset plinth without unsupported trim.

clay.note: Clay preserves straight panel alignment and readable cabinet divisions independently of the white finish.

front.note: The layered platter, record, tonearm and small controls form a detailed recognizable turntable.

rear.note: The tonearm pivot and rear controls remain attached to the stepped chassis with consistent metal finish.

detail.note: Record grooves, platter dots, cartridge and pitch slider remain legible in the close view.

underside.note: Four feet support the closed dark chassis bottom; no loose underside components are visible.

clay.note: Clay confirms that platter layers, arm and controls retain their modeled depth.

front.note: The folded textile retains layered edges, border stripes and fringe with a soft slight surface bend.

rear.note: The opposite edge shows three separate folded layers and aligned trim; the tidy fold is an intentional simple pose.

detail.note: Fine fringe loops and restrained border bands remain readable without large coarse weave.

underside.note: The underside is continuous, with fringe attached along the folded edge and no detached strips.

clay.note: Clay preserves the thin stacked folds and mild curvature; this remains a neatly folded throw rather than a loose drape.

front.note: The throw retains its authored sofa-arm support pose with curved edges and a continuous terracotta surface.

rear.note: The two hanging sides remain connected over a rounded crest, with fringe seated at each lower hem.

detail.note: The close view shows soft hem curvature and modest surface variation; the broad faces remain intentionally restrained.

underside.note: The inner side is continuous and the hanging ends have attached fringe, without a closed box pretending to be cloth.

clay.note: Clay confirms the supported inverted-U drape and curved edges; it is intended to rest over furniture in use.

front.note: Three shallow trays at distinct heights sit on slender connected frames, retaining the stand's clear silhouette.

rear.note: The rear shows the same attached trays and crossbars without floating shelves.

detail.note: Tray rims are smooth and visibly recessed, with consistent green finish and black supports.

underside.note: Tray bottoms are closed and all supporting rods meet their trays; the small foot ends remain seated.

clay.note: Clay confirms three separate usable trays and the stepped support structure.

front.note: The tiled stove retains a recessed brick firebox, grate and distinct flame shapes below the flue.

rear.note: The closed rear plate and tiled side remain continuous beneath the overhanging top cap.

detail.note: The close view preserves individual tiles, firebrick joints, door bars and authored fire details.

underside.note: The hearth and grate remain distinct, with the firebox visibly recessed above the closed lower base.

clay.note: Clay confirms separate masonry, steel frame and modeled fuel/flame construction; source animation remains a separate compatibility gate.

front.note: Four inset green bin fronts and round knobs read clearly within the warm wooden cabinet frame.

rear.note: The closed back and top overhang remain aligned with the two side panels and legs.

detail.note: Fine gaps distinguish all four fronts; the wood surface stays restrained and the knobs are attached.

underside.note: The underside is closed and supported by the retained legs, with a continuous lower rail.

clay.note: Clay confirms the four-bin divisions and bounded framed construction.

front.note: The convection oven retains its glass front, silver handle and compact enclosed appliance shell.

rear.note: The rear and side panels are continuous, with layered trim meeting the top cleanly.

detail.note: Two internal racks remain visible through the glass and the door hinges and handle are distinct.

underside.note: The closed dark bottom and inset rack ends are visible; no stray exterior geometry appears.

clay.note: Clay preserves the door frame, handle and layered shell rather than reducing the oven to one block.

front.note: The timber helper tower retains steps, raised platform and side guard rails with readable joinery.

rear.note: The rear entry and crossbars are open and connected to the broad stabilizing feet.

detail.note: The platform meets its frame and the wood texture remains soft at furniture scale.

underside.note: The underside exposes a supported platform and connected steps with no floating rung.

clay.note: Clay confirms the distinct step levels, guards and wide lower support footprint.

front.note: The smart toilet retains a recessed oval bowl, integrated pedestal and upper control housing.

rear.note: The back housing and bowl remain attached with a continuous smooth porcelain finish.

detail.note: The rim and bowl depth read clearly, while the small side control remains distinct.

underside.note: The closed pedestal supports the curved bowl underside without detached parts.

clay.note: Clay confirms genuine bowl recession and separate seat/control construction; the base remains deliberately simplified.

front.note: The wall-mounted bidet toilet has a smooth suspended bowl and distinct rear controls.

rear.note: The rear mount panel and upper housing remain aligned with the recessed bowl.

detail.note: The close view retains rim depth and small bidet fittings inside the bowl.

underside.note: The suspended porcelain underside is closed and smoothly transitions into the rear mounting structure.

clay.note: Clay confirms a hollow bowl and separate wall support rather than a solid oval placeholder.

front.note: The narrow wooden ladder holds two folded white towels on separate rungs with a coherent rectangular frame.

rear.note: The rear keeps the shelf/rung contacts intact and both towels remain seated over the rails.

detail.note: Wood grain and softened edges are visible; the towels retain a tidy, simplified folded-block appearance.

underside.note: The base rails and lower shelf meet the vertical frame, with no disconnected supports.

clay.note: Clay preserves the two towel levels and slender frame; loose fabric folds are not claimed.

front.note: The fan retains a tall rounded housing, dense horizontal outlet and distinct circular pedestal.

rear.note: The rear housing is continuous and the lower neck remains attached to the base.

detail.note: The vent slats are evenly spaced and readable, without excessive metallic grain.

underside.note: The closed foot and attached lower housing remain visible beneath the grille.

clay.note: Clay confirms the modeled grille and top controls within the slim original silhouette.

front.note: The blue column speaker has a rounded enclosure and a fine recessed front grille.

rear.note: The rear connector panel remains distinct and attached to the continuous shell.

detail.note: Fine grille perforations retain a restrained regular pattern appropriate to the speaker face.

underside.note: The lower shell and feet are closed and seated without a loose base panel.

clay.note: Clay preserves the enclosure shape and small top controls; the fine grille remains primarily a close-view feature.

front.note: Four separate bins remain legible inside the open two-level organizer frame.

rear.note: The rear shows the same individual bins resting within connected rails and upright supports.

detail.note: The close view keeps bin edges separate from the frame, with small softened lips and consistent finish.

underside.note: Closed bin bottoms and a connected lower frame are visible from below.

clay.note: Clay confirms the four compartments and supporting rails independently of color.

front.note: The sofa retains connected track arms, three seat cushions and three back cushions with restrained matte upholstery.

rear.note: The continuous rear frame supports all back cushions without large unsupported gaps.

detail.note: The close view shows mild tailored creasing and consistent seat seams; the cushions remain rounded rectangular forms.

underside.note: A closed dark base and attached legs support the complete sofa width.

clay.note: Clay confirms separate cushions and a continuous supporting frame, preserving the original seating design.

front.note: The pot retains a dense crown and multiple descending vines with individually shaped leaves.

rear.note: The opposite side preserves branching foliage and exposed pot surfaces rather than one broad leaf card.

detail.note: The close view shows folded leaves, stems and subtle color variation; the pot rim remains attached.

underside.note: The pot base is closed and the trailing stems continue coherently beneath the crown.

clay.note: Clay confirms individual leaves and branching vines with a full species-readable silhouette.

front.note: The slab top remains clean, but the two arched supports read as rounded sleeves perched on square piers.

rear.note: The reverse repeats the disconnected-looking bridge-to-pier transition instead of a continuous stone arch.

detail.note: The tabletop edge is smooth; the supporting construction underneath still needs a matched arch cross-section.

underside.note: Full-size inspection shows scalloped coarse bridge ends overhanging the rectangular piers with dark notches at each joint.

clay.note: Clay confirms the discontinuous support silhouette is geometric; retain the slab and rebuild only the two arch assemblies.

front.note: The small table retains a raised tray edge, slender metallic legs and a lower shelf.

rear.note: The rear frame remains straight and the shelf meets the same four supports.

detail.note: The rim is clearly separate from the tray surface and the leg finish stays controlled.

underside.note: The closed shelf underside and leg ends are visible, with no floating shelf corners.

clay.note: Clay confirms two usable levels and a shallow tray lip with connected supports.

front.note: The desk retains its broad top, paired A-frame trestles and two cable grommets.

rear.note: A rear crossbar connects the two trestles below the continuous top.

detail.note: The close view preserves a thin softened top edge and a seated front cable accessory.

underside.note: The underside exposes attached support plates and the rear brace, with complete trestle feet.

clay.note: Clay confirms the distinct triangular supports and original desk proportions.

front.note: The linen shade and tripod silhouette are recognizable, but the shade still lacks visible lamp construction inside.

rear.note: The spreader ring and timber legs remain attached in the original pose; the shade needs a properly open shell.

detail.note: The close view retains the bound hem and timber legs, but no socket or bulb construction is present in the source.

underside.note: The full-size underside shows a broad closed cloth cap across the shade opening, without a named diffuser role to justify it.

clay.note: Clay confirms the cap is geometry rather than lighting; open the lined shade and provide bounded socket/support construction.

front.note: The pot retains a dense upright cluster of individually modeled pink and white tulips and long leaves.

rear.note: The opposite side keeps distinct stems, flower heights and a continuous terracotta pot.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows separate folded petals and veined leaves; the angular botanical language remains intentional and detailed.

underside.note: The pot has a closed recessed base and the stems connect into the planting surface.

clay.note: Clay confirms modeled flowers and foliage instead of texture cards or a single plant blob.

front.note: The 55-inch TV retains its thin bezel, dark screen and two separate support feet.

rear.note: The rear electronics panel remains attached to the slim main housing.

detail.note: The close view shows a softened continuous screen surround and seated lower foot.

underside.note: Both feet meet the lower frame and the underside stays closed.

clay.note: Clay preserves the screen/frame layers and support geometry at the original dimensions.

front.note: The 65-inch screen keeps its clean rectangular bezel and paired feet without altered proportions.

rear.note: The raised rear enclosure remains centered on the continuous back panel.

detail.note: The narrow border and lower stand attachment remain readable without surface artifacts.

underside.note: The lower view confirms both feet attach to the frame and retain their original support spacing.

clay.note: Clay preserves the thin display body and separate stand components.

front.note: The largest TV retains its broad thin screen and distinct paired stand feet.

rear.note: The rear housing and main panel remain aligned across the larger display width.

detail.note: The screen perimeter is continuous and the corner rounding remains restrained.

underside.note: The underside shows two attached feet and a closed lower frame without detached trim.

clay.note: Clay confirms the original large display silhouette and layered rear enclosure.

front.note: Three aligned cabinet fronts and recessed pulls retain the media bench's broad low silhouette.

rear.note: The closed back includes its cable port and remains aligned with the top and plinth.

detail.note: Even front gaps and narrow finger pulls remain legible against the muted green finish.

underside.note: The inset dark plinth supports the full closed cabinet base.

clay.note: Clay confirms straight carcass construction and separate front panels.

front.note: The twin-over-full bunk retains the wider lower mattress, upper guards and attached ladder.

rear.note: Rear rails and both mattress frames remain supported by connected posts.

detail.note: The close view preserves individual rails and neatly layered bedding without large floating pillows.

underside.note: Both deck undersides are closed and attached to the posts; the ladder reaches the lower support level.

clay.note: Clay confirms the asymmetric bed widths and connected guard/ladder construction.

front.note: The classic toilet retains a recessed bowl, separate tall cistern and solid supporting pedestal.

rear.note: The rear tank and bowl connection remain coherent with a continuous porcelain finish.

detail.note: The seat rim, bowl recession and tank lid stay distinct in the close view.

underside.note: The bowl underside meets the closed pedestal and the tank stays supported behind it.

clay.note: Clay confirms the separate cistern and genuinely recessed bowl rather than a solid oval form.

front.note: The toaster retains two deep slots, a front control dial and side lever within its rounded shell.

rear.note: The rear enclosure is continuous and both slot rims remain separate.

detail.note: The close view preserves the browning dial, raised lever and soft manufactured corner transitions.

underside.note: The closed lower shell and crumb-tray detail remain visible without detached controls.

clay.note: Clay confirms two actual slot recesses and the separate control elements.

front.note: The sectional retains two projecting chaises and a connected row of matte rounded-rectangular cushions.

rear.note: The continuous rear frame supports the back cushions and both end sections.

detail.note: Seat divisions and restrained tailored creasing remain legible without contrasting arm caps or loose pillows.

underside.note: A closed base and attached legs support the wide U-shaped seating envelope.

clay.note: Clay confirms the connected supporting frame and distinct chaise geometry.

front.note: The slim hood retains its stepped enclosure and small front controls within the original shallow profile.

rear.note: The rear casing is continuous and aligned with the lower lip.

detail.note: The close view shows a softened manufactured edge and three attached controls.

underside.note: Two banks of filter slits remain clearly visible in the closed extractor underside.

clay.note: Clay preserves the stepped housing and under-cabinet proportions without unnecessary decorative geometry.
